name: Embeddings
description: Canonical gte-small TEXT_EMBEDDING provider. Point EMBEDDING_BASE_URL at an OpenAI-compatible endpoint serving thenlper/gte-small at 384 dimensions. Model and width mismatches fail closed so local and hosted memory vectors remain compatible. Registers only embedding slots.

EMBEDDING_BASE_URL.label: Embedding Base Url
EMBEDDING_BASE_URL.help: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible /embeddings endpoint serving thenlper/gte-small with 384-dimensional output. Setting this (or the API key) activates the plugin.

EMBEDDING_API_KEY.label: Embedding Api Key
EMBEDDING_API_KEY.help: Bearer token for the embedding endpoint. Setting this (or the base URL) activates the plugin. Omit for local servers that need no auth.

EMBEDDING_MODEL.label: Embedding Model
EMBEDDING_MODEL.help: Embedding model identifier sent as the request `model` field.

EMBEDDING_FALLBACK_BASE_URL.label: Embedding Fallback Base Url
EMBEDDING_FALLBACK_BASE_URL.help: Optional fallback OpenAI-compatible /embeddings base URL. Used once when the primary endpoint fails with a network, HTTP, or response-shape error. Does not activate the plugin by itself.

EMBEDDING_FALLBACK_API_KEY.label: Embedding Fallback Api Key
EMBEDDING_FALLBACK_API_KEY.help: Bearer token for the fallback embedding endpoint. Omit for fallback servers that need no auth.

EMBEDDING_FALLBACK_MODEL.label: Embedding Fallback Model
EMBEDDING_FALLBACK_MODEL.help: Fallback embedding model identifier. Defaults to EMBEDDING_MODEL when unset. The fallback result must still match EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS.

EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS.label: Embedding Dimensions
EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS.help: Canonical gte-small vector width. Values other than 384 are rejected to prevent incompatible vector spaces.

EMBEDDING_BROWSER_URL.label: Embedding Browser Url
EMBEDDING_BROWSER_URL.help: Browser-only server-side proxy URL for /embeddings. In a browser build the Authorization header is never sent unless this is set, so the API key stays server-side.
